configs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: seamless strict top-down autumn ground texture for a historical 2D strategy game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the current autumn grass source. Input image 2 is the approved spring detail-scale reference.
Primary request: remake target image 1 with the same readable low grass tuft size and clear organic surface detail as image 2, preserving target's own seasonal palette. At 384px downsample it must read as short grass and irregular turf, not a smooth floor or blurred noise.
Texture: short dry grasses mixed with small remaining green blades, broken straw and occasional tiny exposed earth flecks. Small overlapping low tufts around 12–22 pixels wide and short leaf strokes around 5–10 pixels at a 1024 square canvas. Vary grass density in irregular natural patches, with about 85–95 percent grass cover. Crisp moderate dark undersides and pale straw tips, no smooth blurry gaps.
Palette: muted golden ochre and warm straw brown, scattered dull olive greens; sparse tiny russet leaf fragments; preserve the autumn target's warm overall palette.
Constraints: entire square full of terrain, straight-down orthographic surface, flat diffuse ambient light, seamless tileable edge-to-edge, no perspective or horizon, no trees, no objects, no tall grass rosettes, no giant isolated plants, no flowers, no large dirt patches, no paving, no uniform grain filter, no borders or text. Preserve the game art's detailed painted material style.
